MORE CLARITY. LESS GUESSWORK.

Remote jobs.
A closer look.

A “remote” label doesn’t tell the whole story. Here’s what goes into the OpenRemote board.

01

Find the opportunities

We bring together roles from company career pages and specialist remote-job boards, with links to the original listings.

02

Check beyond the headline

We check descriptions and application requirements for hidden location restrictions, including restrictions that exclude applicants in Nigeria. Listings that exclude the applicants OpenRemote serves are removed before publication.

03

Put the details in your hands

Explore the role, review the employer’s requirements, and apply at the original source. Requirements can change after our checks.
